name: Discrete Polygonal Occlusion via 2D Boundary Coverage
aliases: Emission conditionnelle des innerShell selon les six voisins
definition: A synchronous mesh baking technique that reduces polygon count by determining which inner shell polygons of a voxel cell are occluded by adjacent cells. It uses discrete 2D coverage masks on cell boundaries rather than continuous geometric clipping.
summary: Discrete Polygonal Occlusion via 2D Boundary Coverage is a synchronous mesh baking optimization that reduces polygon count by using deterministic 2D coverage masks to identify occluded inner shell polygons.
